name: particles-bg
blurb: Animated particles that respond to cursor movement with magnetism.
description: Canvas-based particle background where particles move with velocity and are attracted toward pointer. Customizable quantity, colour, and physics parameters.
use_when: An interactive background that engages users with pointer-responsive particle motion.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices — particles only respond to mouse movement. High quantity values on low-end devices may impact performance.
a11y: Canvas overlay with mouse-based interactivity. No touch support or keyboard alternatives.
